cards.name: Glitchling Hexatron

coverage_override.reason: Fresh semantic segmentation found 4 individual printed procedure/effect records. Conjunctions, choices, dependent 'then/and if you do' steps, and their HOPT/use-cap text are kept with the single Lua effect that resolves them; separately functioning procedures, continuous rules, and activated/triggered effects are separate records.

effects.printed_clause: Link Summoning procedure (no material line is present in the current printed text).
effects.lua_implementation: AddLinkProcedure requires 2 or 3 Cyberse monsters for this Link-3 monster, followed by EnableReviveLimit; the current printed text still supplies no material line against which that choice can be proven.

official_references.matched_structure: Official "Orcust" Link procedure requiring Effect Monsters and an archetype member.

effects.issue: Retained as a genuine source ambiguity: a Link Monster needs a material procedure, but the preserved printed text omits the material line entirely. No official reference can determine whether the intended requirement was 2+, exactly 3, Effect Monsters, Cyberse monsters, or an archetype-specific group. The existing 2-3 Cyberse procedure is playable, but cannot be semantically certified without changing or clarifying printed text.

effects.printed_clause: If Link Summoned: add 1 Cyberse Ritual Monster from Deck/face-up Extra Deck and 1 Ritual Spell or Cyberse Normal Monster from GY/face-up banishment; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed Link-Summon-success trigger with id count limit requires both pools, selects one from each, merges them, sends both to hand, and confirms them.

official_references.matched_structure: Summon-success search from Deck/GY with hand confirmation.
Adds an eligible face-up banished or GY card to hand.

effects.printed_clause: Cannot be banished or destroyed by the opponent's cards or effects.
effects.lua_implementation: A single-range EFFECT_INDESTRUCTABLE_EFFECT uses aux.indoval; a field EFFECT_CANNOT_REMOVE targets only this card when the reason is an opponent effect and not a redirect.

effects.printed_clause: Quick Effect: remove all Corruption Counters from an opponent monster as cost; destroy 1 controlled "Glitchling" Monster Card or Cyberse Normal Monster, then negate that opponent monster and gain 200 ATK per removed counter; uses per turn up to differently named Bitron/Protron/Digitron in your field or GY.
effects.lua_implementation: The free-chain counter-removal effect is unchanged, but its per-turn cap now gathers the three exact named cards from LOCATION_ONFIELD+LOCATION_GRAVE, requires named cards on the field to be face-up, and counts different codes with GetClassCount.

official_references.matched_structure: Destroy a controlled named card, then negate/destroy the related opposing activation.
A per-turn use cap derived from a live field count and temporary effect negation.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the old cap omitted face-up named cards in the Spell/Trap Zone and counted face-down Monster Zone cards. It now covers the full field plus GY while excluding face-down on-field identities.

cards.reconciliation_note: All batch_8c findings for this card were re-evaluated against current Lua and the cited official Omega references. Confirmed defects are patched; retained CUSTOM_GAP records explain the remaining engine/source limit.
